_about: The faction catalogue import (verify/from-bsdata.js adeptus-custodes) reads BSData's whole Adeptus Custodes catalogue through verify/from-json.js as the export catalog-adeptus-custodes; this is its hand file. weaponNames: a weapon BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (Wahapedia) by more than the spelling rules of verify/from-json.js can tell, so that GW's profile is found and its values checked; the app keeps BSData's name (New Recruit's, which the in-app import matches), and verify/out/catalog/adeptus-custodes.md lists it as named otherwise.
